definitions.gloss: going to work; attendance at work
definitions.explanation: going to work; attendance at work

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧8⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{出勤|しゅっきん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I go to work at 8 every morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おく}れて→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧{出勤|しゅっきん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}わなかった→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧。
examples.english: The train was delayed and I couldn't make it to work on time.

notes:
{出勤|しゅっきん} means going to work or reporting for duty. As a suru-verb, it means "to go to work", "to report for work".

Common compounds:
- {出勤|しゅっきん}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ (time of going to work)
- {出勤|しゅっきん}⟦{日|び}→日：02249_hi⟧ (workday)
- {出勤|しゅっきん}⟦ラッシュ→ラッシュ：11221_rasshu⟧ (rush hour for commuting to work)
- ⟦{時差|じさ}→時差：03075_jisa⟧{出勤|しゅっきん} (staggered working hours)

Antonym: ⟦{退勤|たいきん}→退勤：04550_taikin⟧ (leaving work)

Related terms:
- ⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧ (commuting)
- ⟦{欠勤|けっきん}→欠勤：07732_kekkin⟧ (absence from work)
